blocks.text: Thank you for the site list and the lease summary. They arrived in good order, and Deborah Gordon already has the cost and utilization work under way against them. The early read on the {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}} footprint is that it is more uneven than the summary alone suggests, with a handful of locations carrying cost out of proportion to how much they are actually used.

Two things would help us keep the baseline moving. Brenda Clayton needs read access to the last two years of occupancy and throughput figures behind the sites your team flagged. We would also like thirty minutes each with the two facility managers who know those locations best. If either request needs a sign-off on your side, tell me who to approach and I will take it up directly rather than leave it on your desk. For the two conversations, any half hour in the next two weeks works for us, so send whatever suits their calendars and we will fit around them.

I know this lands in a week that is likely already full, Sandra Frazier, and I have kept the asks as small as the work allows. Anything that is easiest to send can come straight to me, Cynthia Hart, and I will get it to the team the same day. I will keep this thread as the running record so nothing has to be chased twice.
